name: node-logs-collector-stall
title: 节点日志采集超时与队列卡死修复
description: 修复 SSH 会话超时未覆盖读/等待、worker 永久卡死、同节点重复入队和队列持续溢出。
creator: weibo
notes: Planning complete pending user approval. Pre-existing defect: SSH context stops at dial/handshake, ReadAll/Wait can block forever, scheduler duplicates the same nodes, and Shutdown does not join workers. Plan adds whole-operation close-and-join, strict output limit, per-node single-flight, owned cancellation, aggregate telemetry, and controlled production re-enable. Production collectors remain disabled until a fixed release is verified.
